name: expandable-card
title: Expandable Card
description: Compact card that grows into a centered detail view built on a native dialog, then shrinks back into place on close.

props.name: title
props.description: Card title. Also the heading and accessible name of the open view.

props.name: description
props.description: Short summary. Clamped to two lines on the card, shown in full when open.

props.name: media
props.type: Blade: named slot · React: ReactNode · Vue: #media slot
props.description: Image or illustration. Rendered 112px tall on the card and 192px tall in the open view.

props.name: children
props.type: Blade: default slot · React: children · Vue: default slot
props.description: Extra detail shown only in the open view.

props.name: footer
props.type: Blade: named slot · React: ReactNode · Vue: #footer slot
props.description: Actions at the bottom of the open view, for example Add to cart.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the close button.

props.name: id
props.description: Id of the card button. The dialog uses the same id with a -dialog suffix.

props.name: markasCardMedia
props.description: Angular only. Put the media in <ng-template markasCardMedia> (import ExpandableCardMedia), since it shows on the card and in the open view. An element with the footer attribute fills the actions.

a11y: The card is a real button with aria-haspopup dialog, so Enter and Space open it.
The detail view is a native modal dialog labelled by its heading. Focus moves inside and the page behind is inert.
Escape, a backdrop click, or the close button closes it, and focus returns to the card.
With reduced motion the dialog opens and closes instantly without the grow and shrink animation.

ai.whenToUse: Grids of products, articles, projects, or people where a short summary is enough at first and details open on demand without leaving the page.
rules: Place several cards in a grid, the component renders one card
Keep the card text short; put specs, long text, and actions in children and footer
Do not put links or buttons in title, description, or media, the whole card is a button
Use a page route instead when the detail needs its own URL

id.description: Kartu ringkas yang tumbuh menjadi tampilan detail di tengah layar berbasis dialog native, lalu menyusut kembali ke tempatnya saat ditutup.

props.title: Judul kartu. Juga menjadi heading dan nama aksesibel tampilan detail.
props.description: Ringkasan singkat. Dipotong dua baris di kartu, tampil utuh saat terbuka.
props.media: Gambar atau ilustrasi. Tinggi 112px di kartu dan 192px di tampilan detail.
props.children: Detail tambahan yang hanya tampil saat terbuka.
props.footer: Aksi di bagian bawah tampilan detail, misalnya Tambah ke keranjang.
props.id: Id tombol kartu. Dialog memakai id yang sama dengan akhiran -dialog.
props.markasCardMedia: Khusus Angular. Taruh media di <ng-template markasCardMedia> (impor ExpandableCardMedia), karena tampil di kartu dan tampilan terbuka. Elemen dengan atribut footer mengisi aksi.

a11y: Kartu adalah tombol asli dengan aria-haspopup dialog, jadi Enter dan Spasi membukanya.
Tampilan detail adalah dialog modal native yang dinamai oleh heading-nya. Fokus pindah ke dalam dan halaman di belakang menjadi inert.
Escape, klik backdrop, atau tombol tutup menutupnya, lalu fokus kembali ke kartu.
Saat reduced motion dialog terbuka dan tertutup seketika tanpa animasi tumbuh dan menyusut.

ai.whenToUse: Grid produk, artikel, proyek, atau orang yang cukup menampilkan ringkasan dulu dan membuka detail sesuai kebutuhan tanpa pindah halaman.
rules: Susun beberapa kartu dalam grid, komponen ini merender satu kartu
Buat teks kartu singkat; taruh spesifikasi, teks panjang, dan aksi di children dan footer
Jangan menaruh tautan atau tombol di title, description, atau media, seluruh kartu adalah tombol
Pakai halaman tersendiri bila detail butuh URL sendiri
